# wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account_credential (Data Source)

Get information on a credential of an account of a local domain linked to an application, by
`application_id`, `domain_id`, `account_id`, and `type`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wallix-bastion_application" "web_server" {
  application_name = "web_server"
}

data "wallix-bastion_application_localdomain" "web_local" {
  application_id = data.wallix-bastion_application.web_server.id
  domain_name     = "local"
}

data "wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account" "web_admin" {
  application_id = data.wallix-bastion_application.web_server.id
  domain_id       = data.wallix-bastion_application_localdomain.web_local.id
  account_name    = "web_administrator"
}

# Get the password credential of this account
data "wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account_credential" "web_admin_cred" {
  application_id = data.wallix-bastion_application.web_server.id
  domain_id       = data.wallix-bastion_application_localdomain.web_local.id
  account_id      = data.wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account.web_admin.id
  type            = "password"
}

# Use the retrieved password in another resource, e.g. to provision the target application
output "web_admin_password" {
  value     = data.wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account_credential.web_admin_cred.password
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String)
- `application_id` (String)
- `domain_id` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `password` (String, Sensitive)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Keys

`application_id`, `domain_id`, `account_id`, and `type` are all required to identify the
credential. The data source returns an error if no credential of that type exists on the given
account.

### Credential Type

Unlike `wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account_credential` and
`wallix-bastion_domain_account_credential`, application account credentials only support the
`password` type — SSH keys and certificates are not applicable to application accounts. `type`
must be set to `"password"`.

### The `password` attribute

`password` is marked sensitive. Mark any output or downstream reference that uses it as
`sensitive = true` to avoid leaking the value in Terraform logs or state output.
